description: Hand-curated, CARD/ARO-inspired resistance mechanisms for the MVP. These are NOT pulled live from CARD or generated by RGI/AMRFinderPlus against an uploaded genome -- that pipeline (Layer 2 as originally scoped) needs strain FASTA input and a local CARD/RGI install, which this MVP does not wire up yet. Instead, a strain is defined by picking mechanisms from this fixed reference list (see data/strains/*.json). aro_accession values are illustrative CARD-style identifiers for the general mechanism family, not a live database lookup -- treat them as labels, not citations.

mechanisms.name: CTX-M-15 extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)
mechanisms.description: Hydrolyses penicillins and oxyimino-cephalosporins efficiently; spares carbapenems almost entirely, gives ertapenem partial (porin-loss-independent) attenuation, and is partly checked by tazobactam.

mechanisms.name: KPC-2 carbapenemase
mechanisms.description: Broad-spectrum serine carbapenemase; hydrolyses nearly all beta-lactams in the panel including carbapenems.

mechanisms.name: AcrAB-TolC efflux pump overexpression (marR mutant)
mechanisms.description: Constitutive overexpression of the AcrAB-TolC efflux system lowers effective intracellular concentration across a broad range of substrate classes. Multiplier scales the drug's effective inhibition strength down (0.4 = effective strength reduced to 40% of nominal).

mechanisms.name: GyrA S83L target-site mutation
mechanisms.description: Reduces fluoroquinolone binding affinity at the GyrA quinolone-resistance-determining region. Not FBA-simulable (DNA gyrase absent from the metabolic reconstruction); factored into the confidence/reasoning layer only, not into growth predictions.

mechanisms.name: DfrA1 trimethoprim-insensitive dihydrofolate reductase
mechanisms.description: Plasmid-borne DHFR variant with drastically reduced trimethoprim affinity; effectively bypasses target inhibition at clinical concentrations.

mechanisms.name: Sul1 sulfonamide-insensitive dihydropteroate synthase
mechanisms.description: Alternative DHPS with low sulfonamide affinity, target-bypass resistance mechanism.

mechanisms.name: MCR-1 phosphoethanolamine transferase (colistin resistance)
mechanisms.description: Adds phosphoethanolamine to lipid A, reducing the negative charge colistin binds to. Represented as a reduction in colistin's effective strength rather than a lipid-A-pathway reaction change, since the modification is a chemical decoy, not a metabolic block.

mechanisms.name: ArmA 16S rRNA methyltransferase (pan-aminoglycoside resistance)
mechanisms.description: Methylates the 16S rRNA decoding site, blocking aminoglycoside binding across the class. Not FBA-simulable (ribosome absent from the reconstruction); factored into the reasoning layer's confidence scoring only.

mechanisms.name: FosA fosfomycin-inactivating glutathione transferase
mechanisms.description: Conjugates glutathione to fosfomycin, inactivating it before it reaches MurA. Chromosomal in many Enterobacterales, often under-expressed unless induced -- represented here as a simple binary resistance determinant for MVP simplicity.

mechanisms.name: NfsA/NfsB nitroreductase loss-of-function
mechanisms.description: Prevents prodrug activation of nitrofurantoin. Not FBA-simulable (activation chemistry outside metabolic reconstruction); reasoning-layer-only effect.
